findings.title: Command refers to a variable the container does not define
findings.cause: container worker's command uses $(SLEEP_SECONDS), but the container's env and envFrom define no SLEEP_SECONDS, so the kubelet passes the text $(SLEEP_SECONDS) on unexpanded (it does not read the image's ENV) and the process fails on it; its log says: "sleep: invalid number '$(SLEEP_SECONDS)'"; Deployment worker has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container worker exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 5 times
last lines of container worker's log (current run)
container worker's command refers to $(SLEEP_SECONDS), and its env and envFrom define no SLEEP_SECONDS

findings.fix: Define SLEEP_SECONDS in the container's env (or a ConfigMap in envFrom), or correct the name in the command. To pass a literal $(SLEEP_SECONDS), write $$(SLEEP_SECONDS).
